mapper.select: SELECT tdm42_manl_org_id AS manl_org_id , tdm42_company_id AS company_id , tdm42_exct_id AS exct_id , TO_CHAR(tdm42_start_date, 'YYYYMMDD') AS start_date , COALESCE((SELECT MAX(tdm43_role_nm) FROM tdm43_manl WHERE tdm43_manl_org_id = tdm42_manl_org_id), tdm20_role_nm) AS role_name , f_emp_kor_nm(tdm42_exct_id) AS exct_name , sys01_loc_nm AS loc_name FROM tdm42_manl_org INNER JOIN tdm20_role ON tdm20_role_id = tdm42_role_id INNER JOIN sys01_company ON sys01_company_id = tdm42_company_id WHERE tdm42_manl_org_id = #{manlOrgId}
SELECT tdm_create_data(#{pJobTp}, #{regDate}, CAST(#{pId} AS numeric), CAST(#{companyId} AS numeric), CAST(#{personId} AS numeric), CAST(#{groupId} AS numeric))
